command.label: Command post
command.d: Expandable containers protect sensitive electronic equipment from the elements, with fibre optics, CAT 5 and video conferencing — plus server racks, desks, map boards and TV screens.

medical.label: Field hospital
medical.d: The EHMECC extends an additional 4.5 feet in height: extra head room, a higher-hanging operating-room lamp and a climate-controlled working environment.

kitchen.label: Kitchen
kitchen.d: Kitchens are one of the MECC’s listed configurations. Weatherhaven kitchens range from small self-serve facilities to full-service kitchens that feed a camp of 500 or more.

workshop.label: Workshop
workshop.d: MECC workshops are configured for tire changing, aircraft maintenance and electronic repair — and can be set up and operated on the back of a truck or trailer.
